description: Use for the events ahead that can move Bitcoin: macro releases (CPI, jobs, the Fed), options expiries, the difficulty adjustment and Bitcoin dates, each with its date, Eastern time and one line on why it matters. Example: days 3 lists what lands before the weekend. For today's read and its forces use get_bitcoin_today. Free.

days.description: How many days ahead, 1 to 14. Default 14.

name: get_calendar
title: Bitcoin calendar: what is coming up
